content: Yoyɑkimu, Yosiɑsin bii, Yudɑbɑn sinɑ bokon wɑɑti sɔɔ, Yinni Gusunɔ u Yeremi sɔ̃ɔwɑ u nɛɛ,
ɑ doo ɑ Rekɑbun bweseru deemɑ kpɑ ɑ kɑ tu nɑ nɛn sɑ̃ɑ yerɔ diɑ ye yɑ wɑ̃ɑ ten yɛ̃si yɛ̃sibun teerɔ kpɑ ɑ bu tɑm wɛ̃ mi, bu nɔ.
Mɑ Yeremi u dɑ u Yɑɑsɑniɑ Yeremin bii, Hɑbɑsiniɑn debubu sokɑ kɑ win dusibu kɑ win bibu kpuro, Rekɑbun bweseru kpuro ɡesi.

Mɑ u kɑ bu dɑ Yinni Gusunɔn sɑ̃ɑ yerun dii teeru mi, tèn mi Hɑnɑnu, Yiɡidɑliɑn bii, Gusunɔn sɔm kowo u wɑ̃ɑ. Dii te, tɑ wɑ̃ɑwɑ sinɑ ɑsɑkpɔbun dirun bɔkuɔ, ɡbɑ̃rɑ kɔ̃so, Mɑɑseyɑ, Sɑlumun biin dirun wɔllɔ.
Mɑ Yeremi u bu tɑm bwɑ̃ɑnu wɛ̃ kɑ nɔri u nɛɛ, bu nɔruo.
Adɑmɑ bɑ nùn wisɑ bɑ nɛɛ, sɑ ǹ tɑm nɔrumɔ. Domi bɛsɛn sikɑdo Yonɑdɑbu, Rekɑbun bii, u sun woodɑ wɛ̃ u nɛɛ,

content.text: su ku rɑ tɑm nɔ sere kɑ bɛsɛn bibun bibɔ,
su ku rɑ mɑɑ resɛm ɡbɑɑnu ko,
sɑ ǹ kpɛ̃ sɑ n mɑm ye mɔ.
Adɑmɑ sɑ ko n wɑ̃ɑwɑ kuu bekunuɡinu sɔɔ bɛsɛn wɑ̃ɑru kpuro sɔɔ.
Nɡe mɛyɑ sɑ ko kɑ tɛ tem mɛ sɔɔ,
mi sɑ wɑ̃ɑ sɑ sɔru dimɔ mini.

content: Yen sɔ̃, bɛsɛ kɑ bɛsɛn bibu sɑ Yonɑdɑbu, Rekɑbun biin ɡere ye mɛm nɔɔwɑmmɛ. Sɑ ǹ tɑm nɔrumɔ bɛsɛn wɑ̃ɑrun tɔ̃nu kpuro sɔɔ, bɛsɛ kɑ bɛsɛn kurɔbu kɑ bɛsɛn bibu.
Sɑ ǹ mɑɑ diɑ bɑnimɔ yè sɔɔ sɑ ko n wɑ̃ɑ. Mɛyɑ sɑ ǹ ɡbeɑ mɔ̀, sɑ ǹ mɑɑ resɛm ɡbɑɑnu mɔ̀.
Sɑ wɑ̃ɑ kuu bekuruɡinu sɔɔ. Mɛsumɑ sɑ kɑ bɛsɛn sikɑdo Yonɑdɑbun ɡere ye mɛm nɔɔwɑmmɛ.
Adɑmɑ sɑnɑm mɛ Nɛbukɑnɛsɑɑ, Bɑbilonin sinɑ boko u tem mɛ wɔrimɑ, yerɑ sɑ nɛɛ, su se su dɑ Yerusɑlɛmuɔ, kpɑ su Bɑbilonin tɑbu kowobu kɑ Siriɡibu dukɑ suuri. Yen sɔ̃nɑ sɑ wɑ̃ɑ Yerusɑlɛmu mini ɡisɔ.
Yerɑ Yinni Gusunɔ u Yeremi sɔ̃ɔwɑ u nɛɛ,
nɛ Gusunɔ, wɔllu kɑ tem Yinni, nɛ wi nɑ mɑɑ sɑ̃ɑ Isirelibɑn Yinni, nɑ nɛɛ, ɑ doo ɑ Yudɑbɑ kɑ Yerusɑlɛmuɡibu sɔ̃ ɑ nɛɛ, bɑ ǹ nɛn kirɔbɑ swɑɑ dɑkimɔ kpɑ bu mɑn mɛm nɔɔwɑ?

Wee Rekɑbun bweseru tɑ Yonɑdɑbu, Rekɑbun biin ɡere mɛm nɔɔwɑ ye u nɛɛ, win bibu bu ku rɑɑ tɑm nɔ. Mɛyɑ bɑ ǹ mɑɑ tɑm mɛ nɔrɑ sere kɑ ɡisɔn ɡisɔ. Bɑ ben sikɑdo mɛm nɔɔwɑ. Adɑmɑ nɛ, nɑ kɑ be, Yudɑbɑ ɡɑri kuɑ sɑɑ yee yellun di, mɑ bɑ ǹ mɑn swɑɑ dɑki.

Nɑ bu nɛn sɔmɔbu ɡɔriɑmɑ sɑɑ yellun di, bu kɑ ben bɑɑwure sɔ̃ u win dɑɑ kɔ̃sɑ deri. Bu ku mɑɑ bũnu sɑ̃ kpɑ bu wɑ bɑ n wɑ̃ɑ tem mɛ sɔɔ, mɛ nɑ ben bɑɑbɑbɑ wɛ̃. Adɑmɑ bɑ ǹ sɔmɔ be swɑɑ dɑki, bu sere mɑn mɛm nɔɔwɑ.
Yonɑdɑbu, Rekɑbun biin bweseru tɑ ten sikɑdon ɡere mɛm nɔɔwɑ. Adɑmɑ be, nɛn tɔmbu, bɑ ku rɑ mɑn mɛm nɔɔwɛ.

Yen sɔ̃nɑ nɛ Gusunɔ, wɔllu kɑ tem Yinni, nɛ wi nɑ mɑɑ sɑ̃ɑ Isirelibɑn Yinni, nɑ nɛɛ, wee kon de kɔ̃sɑ kpuro ye nɑ rɑɑ ɡeruɑ mi yu Yudɑbɑ kɑ Yerusɑlɛmuɡibu deemɑ. Domi nɑ kɑ bu ɡɑri kuɑ, bɑ ǹ mɑn swɑɑ dɑki. Nɑ bu sokɑ, bɑ ǹ mɑn wurɑri.
Yerɑ Yeremi u Rekɑbun bwese te sɔ̃ɔwɑ u nɛɛ, ɑmɛniwɑ Gusunɔ, wɔllu kɑ tem Yinni wi u mɑɑ sɑ̃ɑ Isirelibɑn Yinni u ɡeruɑ. U nɛɛ, wee i bɛɛn sikɑdo Yonɑdɑbun ɡere kɑ win yiirebu kpuro mɛm nɔɔwɑ.
Yen sɔ̃, Yonɑdɑbu, Rekɑbun bii wi, u ǹ kɔsirebɑ biɑmɔ win bweseru sɔɔ be bɑ ko n nɛn sɔmburu mɔ̀.
Bɑruku u tireru kusiɑ u ɡɑrɑ
Yinni Gusunɔn sɑ̃ɑ yerɔ
